passages.english: "Spare the enemy at your side — Rufinus commands it! —"
passages.notes: A single line of verse from Claudian's In Rufinum, spoken in mock-ironic tone. "contiguo hosti" may mean the enemy close at hand or bordering [the empire]; the sense depends on context not supplied here. The closing quotation mark is in the source.
